title: Nvidia’s Stock Price Drops After Investigation Into CEO Jensen Huang
summary: The chipmaker’s size and significance to the A.I. trade means that Jensen Huang’s admission of a relationship with a businesswoman suspected of spying for China could reverberate across Wall Street.
